text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: One, two, three, four! …Huh?! Where am I? I'm a… princess?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Hey, Princess! Focus, focus! You won't be ready in time for the ball at this rate!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Yeeees, there sure is! And the prince is coming to meet you there. ☆

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Are you for real?! Well, now it makes sense that I'm practicing danc—
…kami! Kawakami! Come ooon! Wake up, already!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Are you finally awake? Hehe, you're not very ladylike when you sleep. Who falls out of bed during a nap?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Huh? …Did I fall asleep during practice?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: But there's a ball happening soon! Pearl! Let's continue our dance practice!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Ball? Practice? I have no idea what you're going on about…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: But I can feel the fiery passion of your soul! Okay! Let's dance!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Wooo! Nice moves! That's it! Look proud in front of the crowd!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Right! I'll engage my prince straight on with my supreme skill!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I'll make their heart pound with these spectacular moves! Wow, I feel like this is making my legs move faster than ever before!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Hahaha! Why are you dancing, Kawakami?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Because there's going to be a ball! Um… I don't remember when, though!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: But I have to get ready anyway!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After this, Kawakami Princess's running form and technique improve drastically!
